mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_questions (id, title, content, user_id, answer_count, favorite_count, follow_count, view_count, is_resolved, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{content}, #{userId}, #{answerCount}, #{favoriteCount}, #{followCount}, #{viewCount}, #{isResolved}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT q.id, q.title, q.content, q.user_id, q.answer_count, q.favorite_count, q.follow_count, q.view_count, q.is_resolved, q.created_at, u.nick_name AS user_name, u.avatar AS user_avatar, im.id AS image_id, CONCAT('/image/', im.stored_name) AS image_url, ir.sort FROM forum_questions q LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON q.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN images_record ir ON ir.table_name = 'forum_question' AND ir.recipe_id = q.id LEFT JOIN image_management im ON ir.image_id = im.id
q.status = 0
AND (q.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR q.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY
q.answer_count DESC, q.created_at DESC q.created_at DESC q.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_questions WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT * FROM forum_questions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
